articles.title: NASA's New Moon Mission: Two Probes, One Cosmic Tug-of-War
articles.summary: NASA's CAPSTONE 02 will send two probes to the moon to test complex 'three-body orbits' where Earth and moon gravity both pull. They'll fly in formation and swap roles. Launch is set for 2027.

articles.title: DIY Radio Telescope: Detect Dark Matter from Your Backyard
articles.summary: A homemade radio telescope made from roof flashing and a paint can can detect dark matter! By measuring hydrogen clouds' orbital speeds, you can see the invisible stuff that makes up most of the universe. Total cost: under $100.

articles.title: Evolution's Repeat Trick: Same Leaf, Different Genes
articles.summary: In the Galápagos, giant daisies evolved the same lobed leaf shape multiple times—but using different genes each time. This 'parallel evolution' shows nature's creativity. Scientists studied all known Scalesia species.
